Morninghollow · Part III · Future title

Megatroid

The future third game turns the story toward redemption and the restoration of humanity's light.

Story direction

Megatroid turns toward good and reclaims his original name. The player will control him as he works to restore the light he shattered within humanity. This is the current story direction; the detailed redemption arc remains in development.

Production status

Megatroid is a future title. Its engine, gameplay systems, and controls have not been selected or finalized.

Future title

Earlier prototype

A playable earlier prototype exists. It is part of the project's development history and should not be mistaken for the finalized third game.
